stages.name: implement
stages.description: Implements every story in a folder headlessly: a worktree and branch per story, the implementer agent, then the review and feature verification stages

stages.name: review
stages.description: Architecture review of the implementation, looping with the implementation agent until approved

stages.name: feature-verification
stages.description: Verified test plans from stories and verified automated tests once the review approves

stages.name: pr-check
stages.description: Adversarial PR check against the story (acceptance criteria, flow, UI design, style, video): from the Stop hook once feature verification has verified the tests (findings go back to the agent), or on demand with a fix loop to 10/10

stages.name: board
stages.description: Moves the story's card on the GitHub Project board as pipeline events happen (In Progress, Testing, back to In Progress on a product bug, Pending Review with evidence, Failed) and keeps its epic in step

stages.name: retro
stages.description: Lessons for this repository's agents and proposed fixes to the factory, from the agents' logged decisions (this checkout's and the metrics store's)
